clue.text: Tranche of boodle in sterling for Irish quarter?

indicators.note: a tranche is a slice, so a slice of these words holds the answer inside them

explanation.surface: A question about where a slice of the stolen money in pounds might end up in Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tranche of' signals letters hidden across boodLE IN STERling.
explanation.definitionFit: Ireland has four historic provinces, so each one, such as this eastern province, is a quarter of the island.

clue.text: Give in first place with pained expression

parts.note: coming first means being the best
ow is what one says when hurt

explanation.surface: Someone hands over first prize while wincing.
explanation.definitionFit: To bestow a gift or honour is to present or give it.

clue.text: Harpies gallivanting about, like other mythical creatures

indicators.note: harpies roaming about wildly suggests their letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Harpies flying around behave like other creatures of myth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gallivanting' is the anagram signal; harpies and seraphs are both winged beings of legend, which makes the definition's 'other' fair.
explanation.definitionFit: Seraphic means resembling seraphs, the six-winged angelic beings of scripture and legend, so like another set of mythical beings.

clue.text: Less composed editor fighting American over royalty

indicators.note: in a down clue the soldier sits above, so before, the royal letters

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: An editor rattled by a quarrel with a US soldier about the monarchy.
explanation.definitionFit: Edgier means more nervous or on edge, the opposite of calm and composed.

clue.text: Position of bishop and cardinal making one become angry

parts.note: a bishop's see is his seat or diocese
cardinal is a deep red colour, from the robes

explanation.surface: A clash between church ranks over status that drives someone to fury.
explanation.definitionFit: To see red is an idiom for losing one's temper suddenly.

clue.text: That is to say, arranged help for arduous trek

parts.note: SC abbreviates scilicet, Latin for that is to say

indicators.note: the letters of help are put in a different order

explanation.surface: Someone explains that assistance was organised for a gruelling expedition.
explanation.definitionFit: Schlep is Yiddish-derived slang for a tedious, tiring journey.

clue.text: Act the wrong way, cutting precious tree

indicators.note: the reversed word cuts into the word for precious

parts.note: something precious is dear

indicators.note: the word for act is read backwards

parts.note: to act is to do

explanation.surface: Misbehaving by felling a valuable tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the wrong way' turns the verb round, and 'cutting' looks like tree-felling but means going inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The deodar is a Himalayan cedar, a large evergreen conifer.

clue.text: Races one can't complete

parts.note: team races where a single runner covers only one leg, so no one person finishes the whole

explanation.surface: Contests that are impossible to finish.
explanation.definitionFit: In a relay each team member runs a stage, so no lone athlete completes the full distance.

clue.text: Entering a quiet city, changed into shades

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go into the city's name

parts.note: Paris is the French capital

indicators.note: the letters of into are rearranged

explanation.surface: Arriving in a hushed city, someone is transformed into ghosts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' shuffles into, and 'Entering' sends the result inside the French capital just before its final S.
explanation.definitionFit: Shades is a poetic word for ghosts or spirits of the dead, as are apparitions.

clue.text: Leaders in White House the reverse of smart in Washington — what's the downside?

indicators.note: the opening letters of the two words are taken
the slang word is read backwards

parts.note: tony is American slang for stylish or smart

explanation.surface: A White House insider asks what the catch is in being stylish in the US capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the reverse of' reads the slang word backwards; 'in Washington' flags that tony meaning smart is American usage.
explanation.definitionFit: Why not? asks what objection there could be, the same as asking what the drawback is.

clue.text: Weapon in novel Pale Fire

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A gun features in Nabokov's novel Pale Fire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' rearranges PALE FIRE; it is also the genre of Nabokov's book.
explanation.definitionFit: A pea rifle is a small-bore rifle, so it is a type of firearm.

clue.text: Heads off tippler's excessive alcoholic tendency, attachment to bottle

indicators.note: the heads, or first letters, of the next four words are taken off them

explanation.surface: A drinker's tendency to go too far is checked before it reaches the bottle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heads off' takes the first letters of tippler's, excessive, alcoholic, tendency. The drinking scene steers you to the wrong bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: A teat is the rubber nipple fitted onto a baby's feeding bottle.

clue.text: Something sailor needs at that point covered by one side of bridge always

parts.note: in the card game bridge, West and East partner each other as one side

indicators.note: the place word sits within the other letters

parts.note: aye is an old word for always
there means at that place

explanation.surface: A puzzling instruction about what a sailor requires, set at one end of a bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covered by' puts the place word inside the other two; the bridge is the card game, not a ship's bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping a weather eye open means watching for changing conditions, a must at sea.

clue.text: Set piece — it's spelt out, as you can hear, in the other across solutions (apart from 23)

definitions.meaning: a piece set by a setter, the kind of thing in this puzzle

definitions.text: it's spelt out, as you can hear, in the other across solutions (apart from 23)
definitions.meaning: each other across answer holds the sound of one letter of this phrase, as SEE in SEE RED or WHY in WHY NOT

explanation.surface: Instructions for spotting the theme hidden among the across answers.
explanation.definitionFit: A setter sets each cryptic clue, so it is a piece of setting work in its own right.

clue.text: Old man's daily crosswords etc

parts.note: pa is a father or old man, with the possessive s
The Times is a daily paper

explanation.surface: Dad's newspaper and its puzzles.
explanation.definitionFit: Crosswords and the like are hobbies, things done to pass the time.

clue.text: Refer to work Greek character turned up that's prosaic

indicators.note: in a down clue the run of pieces is read upwards

parts.note: to cite is to refer to
op is short for opus, a work
nu is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A literary critic cites a work in which a Greek figure appears as dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Prosaic means plain and lacking imagination, the opposite of poetic.

clue.text: In fact, join a new league?

definitions.meaning: ..., to ally oneself again, read whimsically as joining another alliance

explanation.surface: A query whether a team truly switched leagues.
explanation.definitionFit: Really is an adverb meaning in reality, while re-ally reads as forming another alliance.

clue.text: Playing in position as substitute

definitions.meaning: an ... manager fills a post temporarily

explanation.surface: A footballer coming on and taking a place as a replacement.
explanation.definitionFit: On stage it means performing a part; in office it means standing in temporarily.

clue.text: Leaderless, is deaf — his thing is what'll diminish schools?

indicators.note: each of the four words loses its leading letter

explanation.surface: Someone deaf with an odd hobby is ruinous for schools.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaderless' strips I, D, H and T from the fronts of is, deaf, his, thing. Schools here are groups of fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Fishing at sea reduces shoals, or schools, of fish.

clue.text: If upset, put on such varied neckwear

definitions.note: a plural of a type of neckwear, standing for neckwear generally

indicators.note: in a down clue the first part sits on top of the second
in a down clue, upset means the word if is turned upside down
the letters of such are changed around

explanation.surface: Feeling upset, someone tries on various scarves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' gives FI and 'varied' turns SUCH into CHUS.
explanation.definitionFit: A fichu is a small triangular shawl worn round the neck and shoulders.

clue.text: Problem with equipment, needing good fruit pruned

indicators.note: pruning cuts off the end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: litchi is a spelling of lychee, a fruit

explanation.surface: A gardening fault: kit that requires good fruit trimmed.
explanation.definitionFit: A glitch is a sudden minor malfunction in machinery or software.

clue.text: Quick removal of initial no-no for doctors from pharmacy

indicators.note: removal says one piece is taken out of the shop name
from names the word that the medical no-no leaves

parts.note: first, do no harm is the opening rule of medical ethics

explanation.surface: A swift withdrawal of a banned drug from a chemist's.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removal of ... from' takes HARM out of PHARMACY.
explanation.definitionFit: Pacy means fast-moving, having plenty of pace.

clue.text: Notice changes after English left democratic process

indicators.note: the rearranged letters come after the two abbreviations
the letters of notice are changed in order

explanation.surface: A notice of changes after the English left Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: An election is the vote by which a democracy chooses its representatives.

clue.text: Exactly 50% of disease in one area, part of Europe

indicators.note: the half sits inside the other letters

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: half the disease's name is taken

parts.note: beriberi is a vitamin deficiency disease

explanation.surface: Half of all illness in one region of the Continent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exactly 50% of' gives BERI, and 'in' places it between I and A.
explanation.definitionFit: Iberia is the peninsula holding Spain and Portugal, in Europe's south-west.

clue.text: Live in endless childhood? Certainly!

indicators.note: the verb for live goes inside the shortened word
the last letter is cut off

parts.note: youth is the time of being young
to live is to be

explanation.surface: Asking whether one can stay a child forever, and getting a hearty yes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' gives YOUT, and 'in' puts BE inside before the T.
explanation.definitionFit: You bet! is an informal exclamation of agreement, like of course.

clue.text: Anxious, having no time to get Chinese manual

indicators.note: the letter for time is dropped

parts.note: itching means eager or impatient

explanation.surface: A restless reader with no time for an ancient text from China.
explanation.definitionFit: The I Ching is the classic Chinese Book of Changes, used as a guide to divination.
